title: Stone Doves
subtitle: It seems they could stand there in silence forever.

items.text: Stone Doves
Top Floor, Central Watchtower

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Whoa!
The large Shelter Dove casts a soft glow over its perch.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Is it just me, or is this Dove bigger than the others?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: It is much bigger than the other four.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: And that is for a very good reason. This is the primary Dove.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: It covers the largest area of the campus, while the other four cover the corners.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: To think that the SPDM's been kept safe all this time by these things.
Merel takes a step forward and, just as before, inserts the tester.
The tester whirs to life, and then just as quickly, the sound fades, replaced by a triumphant hue.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: All green. Shelter Dove's functional.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: That's it. We've checked all of them.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: So, snack break, then?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Certainly not! We need to keep patrolling the grounds until the "Storm" is over and everyone is safe.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Oh. So, what, we just keep circling around the school, going up and down the watchtowers?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I know it is far from the sort of glorious mission that the Great Matilda Bouanich is capable of.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: But just think, we are protecting all the staff and students of the school!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Someone must have done the same for us when we were students.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Yeah. I get it.
She chuckles to herself.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: *sigh* I shouldn't complain. I'd much rather do this than fight on the battlefield. And the snacks here are better than the MREs, that's for sure.
She pulls two chocolate-flavored energy bars from her pocket and offers one to Matilda.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Plus, we don't have to hide them from the instructors anymore.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Oh, th-thank you. Um, I suppose it is inefficient to work on empty bellies.
After a moment of hesitation, she reaches out to take the bar.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: They're butter berry flavor, only produced in the 90s. I guess that makes them a little old, but they should taste fine.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Ignore the packaging. I swapped it out to avoid leaking time period info.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Quite thoughtful of you.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Let's go. Remember to lock the blast door in case any students end up wandering around near these restricted areas.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Yes, Lavender?

items.speaker: Lavender
items.text: Ms. Matilda, could you go to the southwestern watchtower right now?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: What's wrong?

items.speaker: Lavender
items.text: There are some strangers at the school gate that are staring in its direction.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Strangers? What do they look like?

items.speaker: Lavender
items.text: They're all adults, and they aren't dressed like the instructors or security.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Please stay safe, Lavender. Merel and I are on our way.
Southwestern Watchtower Perimeter

items.speaker: Lavender
items.text: Over here, Ms. Bouanich, Ms. Van der Veer.
Lavender pops out from behind the bushes and waves the pair over.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Is there anything else you remember?

items.speaker: Lavender
items.text: It looks like they might have come from one of the nearby towns. Not sure what they want. Should I call security?
Matilda and Merel exchange a glance.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: It's best that you leave for now. The Security Assistance Team will take over from here.

items.speaker: Lavender
items.text: But I can help, Ms. Matilda.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I'm certain you would. But students are not allowed to make contact with outsiders.

items.speaker: Lavender
items.text: But I ... Never mind. You're right.

items.speaker: Lavender
items.text: The Monitor Director said she wanted to see me in her office anyway.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Off you go then. You know how much she hates waiting.
Lavender acknowledges the order with a nod, but the worry is plain on her face as she leaves.
Once she's far enough away, the two of them speed toward the southwestern watchtower. The tower stares down at them above a tranquil wooded lake.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Matilda, do we really have to toss them out? They're just townsfolk, aren't they?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Outsiders are strictly forbidden from the SPDM campus. Besides, the "Storm" will be here soon. Maybe we should ...
Uncertainty creeps into her voice.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: No. We must confirm their identities and arrest them if necessary.
A rustling sound coming from the southwestern watchtower draws their attention.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Listen. The watchtower's door just opened.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Then we must go immediately.
First Floor, Southwestern Watchtower
First Floor, Southwestern Watchtower
Met by an open door at the watchtower's base, they tread with caution as they enter the dim, circular room beyond.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Huh? No one's here?

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Where did the guards go? They were right here last time.
All at once, they're struck by a wave of odor, a scent both strange and darkly familiar.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Calm down, Merel. This is precisely why they asked for our support.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: We'll report the situation to the security center, begin an investigation, and eliminate any threats we encounter along the way.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: That button on the wall should contact the security center.
Ever-confident, she reaches out and presses the button without a moment's pause.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Um?

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: It's not working.
Realizing this, Merel pulls her communicator out and punches a few keys.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Oh no. My communicator doesn't have a signal either!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: But this alarm is directly connected to the security center through an underground wire. Its signal can't be blocked unless ...

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Unless someone cut it.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Intruder!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Get down!

items.speaker: Manus Disciple
items.text: ㄠ!

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Manus Vindictae?!
Merel whips around to see a dark figure descending the steps.
Even more shadowy figures emerge and rush downstairs behind it.

items.speaker: Manus Disciple
items.text: ㄞ ... Stop ...

items.speaker: Manus Believer
items.text: The first of them blocks the watchtower's door while the others trap Matilda and Merel from the other side.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Hmph. They're blocking the only way out. These filthy puppets have grown more intelligent.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Think, Matilda. You must find a way to report this to the school and the Foundation.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: The wire is beyond repair, but Lavender was near the watchtower when she called me, which means the signal jammer is only covering a small area. That's it!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Merel, do you think you can reach that window?

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: That window there?

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: It's a bit high, but I guess I could transform into a bird.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Then I shall distract these puppets while you fly out of that window. Keep flying until your communicator has a signal again and report to the Foundation.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: But what about you?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I am Matilda Bouanich, Star Investigator of the Foundation and leader of the Security Assistance Team. You have no need to worry about me.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Now! Go!
Attacking with a string of arcane skills, Matilda runs in the opposite direction of the narrow window.
The light refracting off her crystal draws away their attention.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: I'll be back as soon as I can! Stay safe, Matilda!

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: She turns and fires a shot at the corner of the window.
Merel disappears in a burst of light, and a little blackbird darts through the hole in the glass.
Southwestern Watchtower Perimeter
The blackbird flies from the tower, dodging branches as she swoops downward.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Ugh!
Merel dispels the transformation and crashes to the ground.
Ignoring the pain in her palms, she reaches for her communicator.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Yes! Signal's back!

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Security center, no response. Foundation, ah, alright! I'm through.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: This is Merel of Team Timekeeper. Investigator Bouanich and I have engaged Manus Vindictae at the southwestern watchtower of the SPDM.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Number and purpose of intruders unknown. Requesting backup. Requesting back—

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Matilda!!
The explosions immediately scatter the arcane signal.
All she receives in reply is static.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Update:

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Manus Vindictae has destroyed the southwestern watchtower of the SPDM. Nearby areas will be exposed to the "Storm."

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Matilda, uh, Investigator Bouanich was inside the watchtower when it was destroyed.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: Merel? Are you still there?
Judging from the reaction on the other end, it seems her message wasn't received.
She has no choice but to end the call.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Manus Vindictae are attacking the SPDM?

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: Yes. They have already destroyed at least one watchtower. The rest of the campus is almost certainly in danger.
Her hand flits over the communicator as she switches lines.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: The Pre-Storm Dispatch Center is sending an armed response force to the SPDM. Hopefully, the guards will hold out until they arrive.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Merel and Matilda are already engaged in the fighting.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We need a faster way to get there.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: Well, in that case ...
Marguerite interjects with an understated satisfaction.

items.speaker: Marguerite
items.text: I may be able to help.
